intro: If you're driving through the Ekkamai or Sukhumvit 63 area and want a short, private, fuss-free stay — a spot where you pull in, the curtain goes down, and nobody needs to know a thing — Tong Kao Hotel, known as 999 Hotel, is one of the last surviving classic drive-in motels still operating in Bangkok's Sukhumvit belt · 3-floor building with around 15 rooms at 70/1 Soi Ekkamai 4 / Sukhumvit 63, each with a private enclosed parking bay · rates in the low hundreds of baht per stay — exact pricing is not published online, so call ahead on 02-391-1783 · it isn't a boutique hotel and it isn't meant to be; it's an honest, old-school Thai motel that does what it was built for: privacy, fast in-and-out, and a price that won't make you wince

body.html: What Tong Kao Hotel is — and who it's for — Tong Kao Hotel, also listed as 999 Hotel or 999 Hostel online, is a traditional-style drive-in motel at 70/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63 (Ekkamai 4), Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok · this type of place — the Thai "maan rood" motel where you drive straight in to a private bay — was a fixture across Bangkok from the 1970s through the 1990s, but as land prices in Sukhumvit and Ekkamai soared, most closed · Tong Kao is one of the few that has held on · the audience it serves is specific and hasn't changed: people who drive, want privacy, want it fast, and don't want to navigate an app or a hotel lobby · it is not the right choice if you're looking for a modern room, hotel-standard cleanliness guarantees, a breakfast spread, or a pool · if you're after any of that, you're better off looking at the more conventional hotels elsewhere on this list · but if privacy, a private garage space, budget rates, and a straightforward no-questions entry is what you need — this is exactly that.

Location and getting around — the address is 70/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, which runs off the main Sukhumvit Road at the level of BTS Ekkamai station · BTS Ekkamai is approximately 576 meters away — around a 7-minute walk · so while the motel is clearly designed for drivers, it's also walkable to the train if needed · the immediate Ekkamai area has restaurants, convenience stores, and Gateway Ekamai mall within easy reach · Soi Sukhumvit 63 itself is notably quieter than the main Sukhumvit strip, which makes it well-suited for a discreet, low-profile stay · for drivers, the soi connects easily to Sukhumvit Road and expressway access beyond · getting to Suvarnabhumi Airport takes roughly 31 kilometers, and Don Mueang is about 27 kilometers away.
"Old-school motor inn style — you pull straight into your bay, curtain down, done. No lobby, no check-in queue, no eye contact. Rates in the hundreds of baht. For what it is, it still works."

Rooms and facilities — what we know, and what's honest to say we don't — the building has approximately 15 rooms across 3 floors · the core feature is consistent with classic motel design: each room has a private enclosed parking bay with a curtain or roller-shutter providing visual screening from the outside · you drive in, pull the curtain or shutter closed, and go directly up to the room without passing through any shared interior space · confirmed in-room facilities include air conditioning, a hot shower, and a television · there is 24-hour security on site · there is no breakfast service, no pool, no fitness room, no restaurant · to be fully transparent: detailed room condition information is limited because this property does not list on major booking platforms and has no substantial online review record · it's reasonable to expect the rooms are simply furnished and have not had major renovation in some years — this is a budget motel, not a refurbished boutique · anyone with high expectations around room finish should phone ahead and ask · the contact number is 02-391-1783 or 02-391-6509.

Pricing — "low hundreds of baht" and phone to confirm — the most recent pricing data in public records, from around 2011, showed day rates of approximately THB 390–430 · current rates are not published online, and likely differ from that figure · drive-in short-stay motels of this type in Bangkok typically offer both hourly rates and full overnight rates, both in the low hundreds of baht · for the actual current rate and room availability, call directly on 02-391-1783 — this is not a property where you book through Agoda or Booking.com or any app · that is a feature of the traditional Thai motel model, not a drawback · compared to other short-stay options in the Sukhumvit area, this would be among the lowest-cost options available.

Privacy and the Thai drive-in motel tradition — the reason this format of accommodation survived for decades alongside Bangkok's evolving hotel scene is that it solves a specific problem very cleanly · the architecture — private bay, curtain or shutter, room accessed directly from the bay — provides a level of anonymity that no amount of a standard hotel's "discreet check-in" policy can replicate · in the Sukhumvit and Ekkamai area, where the density of new condo towers and hotel construction has made this land too valuable for most operators to maintain, Tong Kao Hotel represents one of the few remaining examples of this format · one honest note for expectations: as an old property of this type, the room finish is almost certainly basic · scuffed walls, older fixtures, and functional-not-beautiful bathrooms are normal at this price and age · the value exchange here is privacy and price for comfort and modernity — that trade is clear going in.
"Still open in Ekkamai. Old-school feel, drive straight to your room, private garage, price in the hundreds. Good for people who want to be quiet and private without dealing with anyone."

A note on our information sources — in the spirit of full transparency that guides all ThailandAddict reviews: Tong Kao Hotel has no meaningful review count on any major platform at time of writing · Trip.com lists the property but notes zero reviews · it does not appear on Agoda or Booking.com · this review is compiled from available public data including Trip.com, SoiDB Thailand, ThaiTravelLoc, and general knowledge of this accommodation category in Bangkok · we have not stayed at this property · the assessments about room condition and facilities are honest inferences from the type and age of the property, not firsthand accounts · for current, reliable information on room condition, availability, and rates, the only dependable source is a direct phone call to 02-391-1783 before you go.

Summary — Tong Kao Hotel (999) is a classic Bangkok drive-in motel that still operates in the Ekkamai area, serving a need that hasn't gone away even as the neighborhood around it has transformed · its strengths are simple: a private garage per room, fast discreet entry, budget rates in the low hundreds of baht, and a location within walking distance of BTS Ekkamai · its limitations are equally honest: old building, basic rooms, no online booking, no verifiable guest reviews, and facilities limited to the essentials · if you drive, want privacy, and know what a maan rood motel is supposed to deliver — this is one of the few places left in the Sukhumvit belt that still does it.
